svg.title: A nurse is collecting data from a client who reports trouble falling asleep. Which findings should the nurse identify as likely contributors?
svg.desc: Caffeine late in the day, a heavy meal at bedtime, exercise finished too close to bedtime, and anxiety all delay sleep onset. A morning walk actually promotes sleep because exercise helps when it is completed at least 3 hours before bed, and a cool dark room supports sleep rather than disturbing it.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Insomnia Risk Factors
Read the situation
A nurse is collecting data from a client
who reports trouble falling asleep. Which
findings should the nurse identify as
likely contributors?
What fits here
Drinks two cups of coffee after dinner
every night · Eats a large meal within 30
minutes of bedtime · Finishes a vigorous
workout at 2100 and goes to bed at 2200 ·
Reports constant worry…
Why it fits
Caffeine late in the day, a heavy meal at
bedtime, exercise finished too close to
bedtime, and anxiety all delay sleep
onset. A morning walk actually promotes
sleep because exercise helps when it is
completed at least 3 hours before bed, and
a cool dark room supports sleep rather
than disturbing it.
